title: Shortest Signed Window
statement:
Use prefix sums and a monotonic deque to find the shortest nonempty subarray with sum at least S.

Input
Read n S followed by n integers.

Output
Print the minimum length of a nonempty subarray with sum at least S, or 0 if none exists.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000, 1 ≤ S ≤ 10¹⁵. Each value has absolute value at most 10⁹.
